short_name: Forest soil fungal ITS sequencing sample metadata
description: Flat metadata schema for individual forest soil samples sequenced for fungal ITS amplicons using next-generation sequencing across forest types and time points.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record.

site_id.descr: Identifier for the sampling site where the soil was collected.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample name or code used in field/lab records.

forest_type.descr: Forest category at the sampling site, e.g. temperate forest, tropical forest, boreal forest.

biome.descr: Broader ecological setting of the site, if recorded, e.g. temperate deciduous forest, tropical rainforest.

sampling_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

sampling_timepoint.descr: Temporal sampling label or campaign identifier for repeated seasonal sampling, e.g. spring_2025, dry_season, month_3.

season.descr: Season at time of collection, if applicable, e.g. spring, summer, wet season, dry season.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level, in meters.

country.descr: Country where the sampling site is located.

region.descr: Administrative or ecological region of the sampling site, if available.

habitat_description.descr: Brief description of the sampling habitat, e.g. forest floor, rhizosphere-adjacent soil, litter layer, mineral soil.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval from which soil was collected, in centimeters; record as a single depth or depth range description if needed.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or texture description, if known, e.g. loam, sandy loam, clay, organic soil.

soil_pH.descr: Measured soil pH of the sample.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content, reported as percent by weight or equivalent method used in the study.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content, reported as percent.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at the time of sampling, in degrees Celsius, if measured.

soil_nitrogen_percent.descr: Total soil nitrogen content, in percent, if measured.

soil_carbon_percent.descr: Total soil carbon content, in percent, if measured.

vegetation_dominance.descr: Dominant vegetation or tree species associated with the sampling location, if recorded.

canopy_cover_percent.descr: Estimated canopy cover above the sampling point, in percent, if measured.

sample_replicate.descr: Replicate number for the site and time point, if multiple samples were collected.

collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the soil sample, e.g. corer, auger, shovel, sterile scoop.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil collected for DNA extraction, in grams.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample was stored before DNA extraction, in degrees Celsius, e.g. -20, -80.

storage_duration_days.descr: Number of days between collection and DNA extraction, if known.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used for the sample.

target_region.descr: Amplicon target region sequenced, expected to be ITS1 or ITS2 for fungal community profiling.

forward_primer.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for ITS amplification.

reverse_primer.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for ITS amplification.

library_prep_method.descr: Library preparation workflow used before sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used, e.g. Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or batch ID.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length produced by the sequencing run, in base pairs.

barcode_index.descr: Index or barcode sequence identifier assigned to the sample.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads remaining after quality filtering, if available.

chimera_filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads remaining after chimera removal, if available.

otu_count.descr: Number of OTUs detected in the sample, if OTU clustering was used.

asv_count.descr: Number of ASVs detected in the sample, if ASV inference was used.

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Method or database used for fungal taxonomic assignment, e.g. UNITE, BLAST, classifier.

fungal_diversity_notes.descr: Free-text notes on unusual community features, contamination concerns, or field observations relevant to interpretation.

qc_pass.descr: Whether the sample passed quality-control criteria for downstream analysis.
